newsitem.title: USA: Sierra Health merges with Physician - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Sierra Health merges with Physician - WSJ.

text.p: Sierra Health Services Inc has signed an agreement worth $509 million to merge with Physician Corp of America, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
The newspaper said the deal would create one of the country's largest managed-care companies with 1.5 million members in 18 states and $2 billion in annual revenues.

It said holders of a share of Physician Corp would get 0.45 a share of Sierra. It also said Sierra holders would have a 50.5-percent interest in the new company, while Physician holders would own the remainder.

The newspaper quoted Sierra Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Anthony Marlon as saying the companies foresaw $10 million to $15 million in cost reductions per year from overhead savings and other efficiencies.
The new company will keep Sierra's name and head offices in Las Vegas as well as Marlon as chief executive officer, it said.
Sierra is to announce the deal on Monday.
